decisions.reason: The unquotiented plane lacked the sign selection required by Thurston Definition 4.5.1. Made the signed full-turn/eigenline convention explicit and distinguished its intrinsic quotient modulo sign; ordinary slopes, attachments and cone angles are preserved.

The gcd witness already refutes the universal claim, but F1 and 2.1 improperly inferred a realized cone completion. Both now retain the realization condition; no existence claim is needed for the counterexample.

The holonomy supplier actually constructs a slice and affine frames in Proof 8.1–10.1, so no new prerequisite is missing. F1 now cites these constructions precisely and derives the missing zero-log translation ratio by commutativity and continuity across the coordinate hyperplane. Reviewed Lorentz blending, end equivariance, Fermi-coordinate lattice, smooth core, completeness and volume computations; Statement unchanged.

The listed covering and deck interfaces give evenly covered sheets and a free action, but compact-set finiteness was asserted without derivation. Added Proof 3.1: a sheet pair admits at most one deck map; a finite subcover of C×D gives finiteness, and finitely many lifted compact closures give a cocompact set. The later parabolic and centralizer arguments now cite that derivation. Statement and countable-choice hypothesis unchanged.

The current supplier does establish existence: its F3 and Proof 2.1 apply the simultaneous full-turn solution lemma to every tuple in a product exterior-of-radius neighborhood; Proof 3.1 then applies geometric realization. Checked the contraction proof, including zero coordinates, 3/4 denominator bound and uniform contraction. Thus the theorem F1 and Proof 1.1 use an actual proved conclusion, not merely conditional holonomy equations. Its lattice finiteness and length-norm argument are sound.

F5 omitted the supplier’s countable-choice and orientability hypotheses. Restored both and checked Proof 3.1: the orientation extends over the orientation-reversing solid-torus attachment and AC implies ACω. Added the supplier-required AC to the complete Example description, clarified that the cusped metric is on the exterior interior, and restated F7 as the covering definition actually used to verify the explicit pullback. Replaced the ambiguous sphere-like sketch by the oriented square quotient for T² with the same monodromy matrix. The injected torus group and volume argument remain intact.
